changes.title: Cauldron slice
items: A cauldron preview adds mushroom collecting, shared kitchen baskets and a temporary mirror-floor brew.

changes.title: Unlock hats
items: Unlock everything now puts every spell hat on the Cloakroom floor.

changes.title: First night bugs
items: Choosing your usual clothes at a morning station now puts them on, and the panel only marks clothes as worn once you are wearing them.
Pausing at a dressing station hides its panel until you resume, so the pause controls stay readable.
Holding Use at a stump that is not ready no longer puts your hat down.
Fully hidden pointers no longer expose invisible distance labels to screen readers.
